messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Baker <sam.baker@healthtech.io>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@healthtech.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Trial success protocols and staged cutover — HealthTech MAP

Hi Sam / Olivia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited by the integration progress. As promised, attaching a first-draft mutual action plan that focuses on concrete success signals, exit gates, and the acceptance tests we think will demonstrate production readiness for the 3-week pilot. High-level summary:

- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for real-time triage and summarization within HealthTech's clinician UI with measurable latency, accuracy, and cost targets.
- Trial length: 3 calendar weeks (kickoff, integration + smoke, verification + signoff).
- Success signals (examples): P95 latencies < 250 ms for 512-token requests; exception rate < 0.5%; semantic match score (internal eval) > 0.90 on the HealthTech prompt set; 95% throughput of expected daily volume under reserved pool.
- Exit gates: failure at any configured smoke test for 2 consecutive days -> freeze + rollback; failing security/compliance doc review -> pause on data ingress.
- Acceptance tests: endpoint throughput test, integration sanity tests (end-to-end), a 1000-sample concordance set we will run together, and a billing sampling check to validate unit economics.

I've attached: MAP_HealthTech_v1.pdf (draft) and a short list of trial test cases. Please flag any missing items or constraints from procurement/security. Once we align, we'll update the MAP to a versioned doc and lock the timeline.

Next asks from us:
1) Confirm the three-week window (preferred start week: Oct 19)
2) Point person for procurement signoff and preferred DocuSign contact
3) Any mandatory security evidence beyond a SOC2 summary and data flow diagram

Happy to jump on a 30-min call Monday to run through.

Thanks,
Avery

--

Thanks Avery — this is very helpful. A few quick clarifying Qs before we lock dates:

1) For the concordance set, can you confirm what metric you use for the semantic match score? We need the definition to map to our QA signoff.
2) On the latency targets: our UI team will need P95 under synthetic load AND during a small live-traffic window. Can we schedule a live traffic window in week 2?
3) Procurement needs a statement of any trial credits and whether there’s a one-time setup fee. Also, please provide the SOC2 coverage summary and redacted evidence we can share internally.

If you can provide those items and a short test matrix, procurement can turn the paperwork around quickly.

Sam

Looping in the test/QA plan — Sam, quick answers inline and a link to the test matrix: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cMAP-HealthTech

- Semantic match score: we use a cosine similarity over our lab-validated embedding space on the 1k concordance set; we’ll provide the exact scoring script. Threshold: > 0.90 (we can accept 0.88 for an initial pass but must remediate to 0.90 within 2 weeks).
- Live traffic window: yes, propose a 2-hour live verification window in week 2 (we’ll coordinate a feature flag and can route a 5% sample).
- Trial credits: we can provide a pilot credit of $6,000 applied to usage during the trial; setup fee waived. Will show line item in updated MAP_v2.
- SOC2: attaching a redacted SOC2 summary and a short evidence checklist that maps to the procurement asks.

Attached: trial-test-cases.xlsx (test list + owners) and a lightweight runbook. Acceptance test highlights:
  * Smoke: topology + auth + routing checks (automated)
  * Load: 500 rps synthetic test for 15 minutes with monitoring hooks
  * Concordance: 1,000 sample evaluation, run jointly, seed & scoring script included
  * Cost check: per-token billing reconciliation for a 48-hour sample run

I’ll update the MAP doc to reflect these and drop v2 to the Drive tonight.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Sam / Olivia / Procurement team,

Thanks — updated items below and next steps. I’ve attached MAP_HealthTech_v2.pdf which consolidates the success signals, the runbook links, and procurement language. Key points:

- Timeline (proposed):
  Week 0 (Oct 19) — Kickoff, environment provisioning, and baseline smoke tests
  Week 1 (Oct 26) — Integration + synthetic load (500 rps smoke + monitoring)
  Week 2 (Nov 2) — Live verification window (2-hour 5% sample) + concordance run
  Week 3 (Nov 9) — Final verification, cost reconciliation, and signoff

- Rollback SLA: if a critical failure (unauthorized data exposure, P95 latency > 500 ms for > 30 minutes, or error rate > 2%) occurs during the live verification window, Redwood will initiate automated rollback to the safe variant and open a post-incident review within 24 hours. Language added to MAP v2.
- Pilot credit: $6,000 line item on the pilot invoice; not conditional on future commitments.
- SOC2 & data flow: attaching a redacted SOC2 summary and a simplified data flow diagram. Please note PHI is tokenized at the ingress proxy; the MAP includes the exact masking rules.
- DocuSign: please send procurement contact and we will return a signed amendment within 48 hours.

Next actions:
1) Procurement to send DocuSign contact and any final legal redlines
2) HealthTech to confirm start week (Oct 19) by EOD Monday
3) Redwood to schedule a 30-min kickoff for Oct 19 morning PST

I’ll be on the kickoff and Marissa will own the trial verification steps. Thanks all — attaching: MAP_HealthTech_v2.pdf, Trial_Test_Matrix.xlsx, SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf.

Best,
Avery
